svg.title: 07 Outcome review & signal mapping

g.text: Mbarara District allocated UGX 120M in its FY26/27 budget for solar irrigation demonstration sites

svg.text: Outcome harvesting template · all fields mandatory
What changed, who changed it, when and where

g.text: In August 2026 the Mbarara District Council approved a UGX 120 million line in its FY2026/27 budget to establish four solar-powered irrigation
demonstration sites with farmer groups in Bubaare and Rubindi sub-counties. This is the first district budget allocation for PURE in agriculture in the
Shows local government moving from hosting pilots to funding them — an early LEVERAGE signal that RA-PURE can be sustained through public budgets
NREP and USEA presented adoption and yield evidence at two district budget conferences and supported the production office to cost the sites.

svg.text: Every approved outcome must link to at least one verifiable source
